units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:1">Yoma V, 1</cite> <he>לא היתה שם אלא פ׳ אחת</he> only one curtain was there (in the Second Temple, between the Holy and the Holy of Holies).

<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מהלך … עם הפ׳</he> he walked to the left alongside the curtain. Ib. 4; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פָּרוֹכוֹת</he>, <he>פָּרֹכוֹת</he>, <cite ref="Q01688"><he>פָּרוֹכֶת</he></cite>. Ib. 1 (51ᵇ) <he>שתי הפ׳ המבדילות וכ׳</he> (Talm. ed. <he>הפרוכת</he>, Ms. L. <he>הפרכות</he>) the two curtains which formed the partition between …, and between which was a space of one cubit (v. <cite ref="I00836"><he>טְרַכְסִין</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 5:1">Shek. V, 1</cite> <he>על הפרכות</he> (Y. ed. <he>הפרוכת</he>) superintendent over the manufacture of the Temple curtains; Y. ib. 49ᵃ <he>ממונה על אורגי פ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 106a:12">Keth. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>י״ג פרכות היו וכ׳</he> there were thirteen curtains in the (Second) Temple; <cite ref="Yoma 54a:15">Yoma 54ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="Q01688"><he>פרוכת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 54a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ דבבי</he> the curtains at the Temple gates; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 41:15">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLI</cite> <he>פָּרֹכִיּוֹת שחורות</he> black curtains.
